title: Halong Bay Overnight Luxury Cruise
description: Embark on an ethereal journey through the limestone karsts of Halong and Lan Ha Bay aboard a meticulously crafted boutique luxury vessel.
content:
> **Executive Summary:**
>
> *   The "Halong Bay Overnight Luxury Cruise" offers a 2-day/1-night experience aboard a Heritage Line boutique vessel, focusing on the secluded Lan Ha Bay, a UNESCO site, with private limousine transfers from Hanoi.
> *   Guests experience multi-course fine dining, sunrise Tai Chi, and kayaking through sea caves, with the cruise designed to pair well after a rigorous golf schedule in the Hanoi region.
> *   Booking through Asia Golf Specialists (AGS) ensures priority reservations, skip-the-line access, and luxury private SUV transfers, with the experience available year-round.
>
> *Related: Explore our [Premium Southeast Asia Tours](/tours/) luxury itinerary.*

## The AGS Executive Summary
Embark on an ethereal journey through the limestone karsts of Halong and Lan Ha Bay aboard a meticulously crafted boutique luxury vessel.

## The Operator & Origin Story
Heritage Line operates the most prestigious fleet of boutique cruise ships in Southeast Asia. Their specialized itineraries focus on the more pristine, secluded Lan Ha Bay, preserving the absolute majesty of this UNESCO site.

## The Itinerary & Deep Dive
Your journey begins with a private limousine transfer from Hanoi. Upon boarding, you check into a spacious suite featuring a private balcony. Anchor is dropped in a secluded cove where you can kayak through striking sea caves. 

As evening falls, a multi-course fine dining experience is served on deck, followed by sunrise Tai Chi session on the sundeck the next morning.

## Experience Data
| Metric | Details |
|---|---|
| **Vibe / Atmosphere** | Majestic, Tranquil, Luxurious |
| **Duration** | 2 Days / 1 Night |
| **Physical Demand** | Low |
| **Best Paired With** | Following a rigorous golf schedule in the Hanoi region. |

## Pairing a Lan Ha & Halong Bay Boutique Cruise With Northern Vietnam’s Cliffside Links
Located 2 to 2.5 hours east of Hanoi via the modern Hanoi–Haiphong–Halong expressway, the UNESCO limestone seascape of **Halong Bay and Lan Ha Bay** forms the natural finale to our [Hanoi & Halong Bay](/tours/hanoi-halong-bay/) golf itinerary. Better still for avid golfers, Quang Ninh and Haiphong provinces host three of Northern Vietnam’s most spectacular championship layouts right along the bay transit corridor:
* **[FLC Halong Bay Golf Club](/courses/vietnam/flc-ha-long-bay/) (Par 71, 6,092 yards):** A Schmidt-Curley cliffside target course perched directly above Halong Bay, where holes 8 and 12 look straight down onto 1,600 emerald limestone karsts and wooden junk boats.
* **[Dragon Golf Links](/courses/vietnam/dragon-golf-links/) (Par 72, 7,361 yards):** Greg Norman’s seaside links built on a dramatic coastal peninsula in Do Son (Haiphong), just 25 minutes from the Got Ferry / Cat Hai cruise pier for Lan Ha Bay.
* **[Silk Path Dong Trieu Golf & Country Club](/courses/vietnam/silk-path-dong-trieu/) & [Chi Linh Star Golf & Country Club](/courses/vietnam/chi-linh-golf/):** Championship valley courses situated directly along the highway between [Sofitel Legend Metropole Hanoi](/accommodations/vietnam/sofitel-metropole-hanoi/) and the coast.

## Seamless Golf-to-Yacht Logistics & Suite Curation
* **Morning Cliffside Round or Direct Pier Embarkation:** Groups can play an early morning round at [FLC Halong Bay Golf Club](/courses/vietnam/flc-ha-long-bay/) (staying the night prior at [FLC Grand Hotel Halong](/accommodations/vietnam/flc-halong-bay/) or [Legacy Yen Tu - MGallery](/accommodations/vietnam/legacy-yen-tu-m-gallery/)) before boarding their Heritage Line vessel (*Violet*, *Ylang*, or *Ginger*) at noon—or transfer straight from Hanoi after playing [Legend Hill](/courses/vietnam/legend-hill/) and [Van Tri Golf Club](/courses/vietnam/van-tri-golf-club/).
* **Dedicated Golf Bag Custody:** While you spend 24 to 48 hours kayaking hidden lagoons in Lan Ha Bay, practicing sunrise Tai Chi on the sundeck, and dining on seven-course seafood menus, your chauffeur keeps your bulky golf travel covers locked inside your luxury private touring vehicle at the marina or transfers them ahead to Noi Bai Airport for your onward flight to Da Nang.

faqs.q: Which golf courses are located near the Halong Bay and Lan Ha Bay cruise piers?
faqs.a: FLC Halong Bay Golf Club overlooks the limestone karsts of Halong Bay itself (15 minutes from Tuan Chau Marina), while Greg Norman's Dragon Golf Links in Haiphong sits 25 minutes from the Lan Ha Bay embarkation pier.

faqs.q: What happens to our golf clubs while we are on the overnight Halong Bay luxury cruise?
faqs.a: Your dedicated Asia Golf Specialists transport team either checks your golf bags into secure bell storage aboard the Heritage Line vessel or holds them safely inside your locked private vehicle for direct delivery to Hanoi's Noi Bai Airport upon disembarkation.

faqs.q: Why does Asia Golf Specialists recommend Lan Ha Bay vessels like Heritage Line over standard Halong Bay boats?
faqs.a: Heritage Line's all-suite boutique ships sail into the quieter southern waters of Lan Ha Bay, offering larger private balcony suites, hydrotherapy spas, and kayak access to uncrowded lagoons away from mass day-tripper boats.
